zh: 我们给木地板刷了清漆。
他们正在给新房子的墙抹灰。
en: They're {plastering} the walls in the new house.
You need to {drill} a hole in the wall first.

zh: 他往墙上钉了一颗钉子。
en: He {hammered} a nail into the wall.

zh: 他用一块木头刻了一把勺子。
en: He {carved|whittled} a spoon out of a piece of wood.

zh: 他把那块木板钉在了墙上。
en: He {nailed} the board to the wall.

zh: 我钉钉子的时候把钉子敲弯了。
en: I {bent} the nail while I was hammering it in.

zh: 我把断掉的把手又粘回去了。
en: I {glued|stuck} the broken handle back on.

zh: 我们用螺栓把书架固定在了墙上。
en: We {bolted|screwed|fixed|attached} the bookshelf to the wall.

zh: 建筑工估计这活儿要三周才能干完。
en: The builder {estimated|reckoned} the job would take three weeks.

zh: 用绳子把拖车上的货物固定好。
en: {Secure|Tie down|Fasten} the load on the trailer with rope.

zh: 你需要把这颗螺丝拧紧。
刷漆之前先把木头打磨一下。
en: {Sand} the wood before you paint it.

zh: 他拧开了遥控器的后盖。
en: He {unscrewed} the back of the remote.

zh: 我们把碎石铲进了手推车。
en: We {shovelled|shoveled} the gravel into the wheelbarrow.

zh: 这个周末我们在重新粉刷装修客房。
en: We're {decorating|redecorating|painting|doing up} the spare room this weekend.

zh: 铺地砖之前得先把地面弄平。
en: We need to {level} the floor before laying the tiles.
